# Sonos Volume Bridge

> An independent, free, MIT-licensed desktop utility that synchronizes the volume and optional mute state of one computer audio output and one Sonos speaker over the local network.

## Product facts

- Supports system volume controls, keyboard volume keys, and supported audio-device controls.
- Optional two-way synchronization reflects speaker volume changes on the computer.
- Settings include a maximum speaker volume, volume mapping, output selection, and start at login.
- Night schedule applies one global weekly half-hour schedule to the selected compatible speaker only, with rectangular selection and optional native start/end notifications.
- Does not play, stream, capture, or redirect audio. It does not replace the Sonos app.
- macOS download: Apple Silicon (ARM64) only, macOS 13 or later. Intel Macs are not supported by this download.
- Windows: Microsoft Store and a separate unsigned direct installer.
- Linux: Ubuntu on AMD64 with PulseAudio or PipeWire and pactl.
- Hands-on speaker testing is currently limited to Sonos Ray; other models need validation.
- The app has no advertising, analytics, or publisher telemetry. Settings and diagnostic logs are stored locally unless the user chooses to share them.
- Not affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, or supported by Sonos.

The website offers optional analytics and advertising through Google Tag Manager after consent. This is separate from the desktop app. See the website privacy notice for choices and storage details.
